svg.font-family: Nunito, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The model asks, your code runs
svg.desc: Four cards: your request and the tool definitions go in as text; the model writes a request with a function name and arguments; your own code runs the function; the result goes back and the model answers or asks again. A loop arrow shows the repeat until the model answers, or a step cap stops it.

g.text: The model asks, your code runs
A function call is a request the model writes and your own program carries out.
it writes a name and arguments
the function is in your code
then it answers or asks again
repeat until the model answers, or a step cap stops it
